## Pathway to Achieving an A* in A-Level Mathematics
Welcome, students! Advanced Level (A-Level) Mathematics is a highly respected qualification and a vital pathway for admission to prestigious global universities in STEM, Economics, and Finance. 

K-Education Hub provides dedicated revision materials, topic-by-topic study notes, and fully interactive past exam paper banks for the three primary learning branches: **CIE**, **Edexcel**, and **Other boards** (such as AQA/OxfordAQA). Select your exam board below to get started.
:::

## Choose Your Exam Board

Select your specific exam board to access modular lesson sheets, step-by-step revision notes, and official exam archives with interactive search filters:

::: {.program-grid}

::: {.program-card}
### CIE Mathematics (9709)
**Cambridge Assessment International Education**

- Academic curriculum divided into modular units.
- Covers Pure Mathematics (P1, P2, P3), Mechanics (Paper 4), and Probability & Statistics (S1, S2).
- Highly structured assessments emphasizing deep theoretical knowledge, mathematical proofs, and algebraic rigor.

[Explore CIE Resources &rarr;](cie/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### Edexcel Mathematics (IAL)
**Pearson Edexcel International A-Level**

- Flexible modular assessment structure allowing students to sit exams in multiple series (January, June, October).
- Covers Pure Mathematics (P1, P2, P3, P4), Mechanics (M1, M2), and Statistics (S1, S2).
- Highly practical approach with exam questions focusing on real-world applications and calculator proficiency.

[Explore Edexcel Resources &rarr;](edexcel/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card}
### Other Exam Boards (Others)
**AQA, OxfordAQA, and General A-Level Curriculums**

- High-quality resources for students taking AQA, OxfordAQA, or equivalent general A-Level specifications.
- Core math concepts aligned across all major international boards, focusing on Calculus, Algebra, and Data Interpretation.
- Practice worksheets and generalized exam revision tools to reinforce exam readiness.

[Explore Other Resources &rarr;](others/index.qmd)
:::
